en.topic_title: Hong Kong’s struggling Star Ferry seeks 30% fare hike, proposes pet-friendly route
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong’s struggling Star Ferry is asking the government to let it hike fares by around 30 per cent. It is also proposing a pet-friendly service on its service between Tsim Sha Tsui and Wan Chai.



The Star Ferry. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



In a submission to the legislature by the Transport and Logistics Bureau, the iconic cross-harbour passenger service is hoping to raise ticket prices by 80 cents to HK$2 per trip.
